s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a yellow bed with a duck-head bedpost, and a nightstand with a lamp and a mug

beats.text: Pax and Polly lie side by side in bed under the covers, Polly snuggled against him with blushing cheeks while Pax looks at her
Pax closes his eyes and lifts a flipper over the covers while Polly lies beside him watching
Pax rolls onto his side away from Polly and settles down, while Polly props herself up beside him

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: bed-band scale 1.004 at f5 rising steadily to 1.091 at f100 (lamp band agrees); compare 0/100 every edge doubled. Otherwise keepable: leads visible, no overlay, on style. The orange penguin-face mug is a generic prop (not a lead)

spans.view: with the duck-head bedpost and the lamp behind her

beats.text: Polly sits propped up in bed, opens her eyes and gazes ahead with a sad, worried frown
Polly squeezes her eyes shut, then opens them with tears welling up, still frowning

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: bedpost/lamp band scale 1.004 at f105 rising steadily to 1.037 at f149; compare 101/149 every edge doubled. A sliver of Pax's body under the covers shows at the bottom-left corner (not listed).
